title: "Not 5 wickets, It was Usman Khawaja’s day" | Stuart Broad post day press conference | Ashes 2021-22
quote_text:
Stuart Broad: "I feel like over the years of my career that I’ve enjoyed pressure moments I’ve never sort of shied away from those so we know with ash's cricket we see how much it means to players when they get hundreds so how much it means to players when they can take sort of positive wickets in a test match, there's no better feeling to do it in ashes's cricket whether that's my upbringing with my old man having had an impact in Australia in ashes's cricket I don't know but it means the world to me so I enjoy playing against Australia I always find them a really tough battle and that's why I play sport I play the sport for the competitive side of it I love that competitive side of it I love trying to get the opening batters out and working your way through that and I think that's why I keep sort of chugging in keep coming for more because it's quite addictive that competitive side of the sport and I certainly felt that today thank you good night well bowled a couple if I may and you've sort of answered one of them a little bit there but presumably I mean you don't have to keep doing this you"
